name: Cream & Onion
description: Our classic. Whole makhana dry-roasted in rice bran oil, then tossed in a creamy, savoury seasoning with a mellow onion finish. Light, crisp and easy to keep reaching for.
ingredients: Roasted Makhana, Rice Bran Oil, Sugar, Salt, Maltodextrin, Hydrolysed Peanut Protein, Dehydrated Blend of Whey (from Milk), Stabiliser Emulsifier (INS 339), Acidity Regulators (INS 330 & INS 296), Cheese Concentrate, Colour (INS 160c), Nature Identical Flavouring Substance, Flavour Enhancers (INS 627, INS 631). Contains added Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances.

name: Peri Peri

Contains added Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances.
